title: Preset Expansion Table
description: Maps preset names (e.g., 'iris', 'crossfade', 'push') to the canonical track or graph-node structure they expand into. Used by the canonicalize function when it encounters { preset: "<name>", ... } inside a transitions block or effects entry. Adding presets here is a versionless change — it composes existing canonical primitives without contract changes.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor tooling. Optional.

preset.description: Author-side preset name. Becomes TransitionIntent::Preset { preset: '<name>' } in canonical output for kind=transition.

kind.description: transition: expands to canonical tracks plus TransitionSpec wrapping. effect-stack: expands to one or more graph nodes attached at the element pipeline.

params.description: Author-side params this preset accepts. Type info drives envelope lifting and validation messages.

tracks.description: Canonical tracks emitted (kind=transition only). Templates may reference author params via {{paramName}} substitution.

subjects.description: Default TransitionSubjects. May be overridden at the canonical level. kind=transition only.

default.description: Default applied when author omits this param. Author-side form (not pre-canonicalized).

appliesTo.description: Names of tracks or nodes that consume this param (cross-references the templates below). Used by docs generators and validation.

kind.description: Canonical track kind (e.g., 'visibility.fade', 'opacity.fade', 'motion.translate', 'relation.push'). Must match a primitive the V3.1 contract knows.

if.description: Optional gating: only emit this track when an author param matches the predicate. Example: { "shape": "circle" } emits only when author wrote shape=circle.

id.description: Optional stable id for the emitted node; canonicalize will deduplicate or auto-suffix as needed.
